versions.changelog:
- Initial release of gif-maker.
- Convert image sequences or sprite sheets into high-quality GIFs.
- Supports custom FPS, layout splitting (e.g., 4x4), and loop settings.
- Smart compression to target file size (e.g., for WeChat stickers).
- Easy setup: automatically creates a virtual environment and installs dependencies.
- Command-line usage with clear parameter options for flexible GIF creation.
